title: ever MADISON|Chiffon Illusion V-Neck Flutter Sleeve Front Slit Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
This beautiful A-line evening dress features loose short sleeves that rest near the elbows, offering coverage. The plunging v-neck with a sheer illusion panel and plunging v-back complement the cinched waist and daring front slit.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Closure: Concealed zipper up the back..


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.


Length: Floor-Length.


Sleeve Style: Half sleeves.


Fabric:Shell:100%Polyester,?
Lining:100%Polyester.


Occasion: bridesmaid dress, formal dress, mature dress, plus size evening dress, evening gown, mother of the bride dress, banquet, wedding.
